title: Go big. Or go haunt.
subject: PNN: The Pyro Posse airs the dirty laundry. Clueso has questions.
preheader: Scorched laundry, a For Sale sign, and one team that says nobody else is playing.

sections.heading:
Go big.
Or go haunt.

runs.text: Every elaborate pink plan begins with a reasonable idea. The difficulty, Inspector Clueso suspects, is getting anyone to leave it reasonable. This is also why the pink team has never been caught: nobody could follow the paperwork.
The Prowling Purrpetrators remain
guilty until proven guilty.
This edition examines their planning philosophy, suspicious science, and considerable confidence. Elsewhere, the Pyro Posse has been lighting laundry. Clueso considers this a rude interruption.

sections.kicker: SPECIAL REPORT / THE PINK PLANNING DESK

sections.heading: The three stages of Purrpetrator engineering

runs.text: 01 / The reasonable concept
Small. Simple. Entirely achievable. Naturally, someone objects.
02 / The logistical reality check
Someone explains how much work it will take. The committee hears this as a dare.
03 / The Purrpetrator clause
“What if we actually did it?” The sensible version is quietly removed from the minutes.
Clueso's planning model: a five-minute idea, a three-day production department, and a budget of 'we'll figure it out.' Clever and fun remains the brief. Being mean does not improve the design.

sections.heading:
Peer review pending.
Victory already assumed.

runs.text: The fictional Institute of Competitive Chromatics has supplied the following figures.
These are comedy statistics, not research or game standings.
The decimal points are doing most of the work.

items.text: **Claimed pink win advantage.** Apparently, confidence now comes with a spreadsheet.
**Claimed opponent realization time.** Clueso was suspicious considerably sooner.
**Claimed October surge.** Even the calendar has been recruited into the publicity department.
**Pink teams apprehended to date.** Clueso has requested a recount and a bigger net.

runs.text: PNN assessment:
a remarkable amount of certainty for a color. Clueso has requested the methodology. Preferably in something other than pink ink.

sections.kicker: THE PINK ADVANTAGE / SPOOF SCIENCE DESK

sections.heading:
Same cat.
Different level of confidence.

runs.text: The pink mascot mythology has three essential skills: remain calm, raise one eyebrow, and walk away as though the outcome was arranged last Tuesday. Sunglasses are apparently a strategic qualification.
Turn up late? Call it an entrance. Complicated plan? Adjust the sunglasses. Something goes wrong? Maintain the walk until someone else starts doubting themselves.
Clueso's finding:
the Prowling Purrpetrators have confused looking unbothered with having an alibi. Annoyingly, it photographs well.

sections.kicker: THE MASCOT FILE / ORIGIN OF THE ATTITUDE

featuredCase.teaser: **Three teams. One night.** A clothesline, a lot of laundry, a little fire, and a For Sale sign that did not ask for any of this. The Pyro Posse says it is the only team playing. Clueso says *that is not the problem.* Case file PNN-005 contains photographs, **a poem narrated by underwear,** and one very quick delete button.
